simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תֹּמֶר (H8560) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תֹּמֶר (tômer) means a palm trunk First listed occurrence: Jer 10 5.

definitions.full: H8560. tomer תֹּ֫מֶר noun masculine palm-tree, post ; — construct ׳ת דְּבוֺרָה Judg 4:5 palm-tree of Deborah; ׳כְּת מִקְשָׁה Jer 10:5 like a post (i.e. a scare-crow ; compare Baruch 6:70) in a cucumber field (simile of idol).
